Note:- Carry out endoscopic inspection of suction branch pipe and Exhaust branch pipe.

0501. First Cold Start

Prior to Start undertake following:-
  • 1. Ensure no machinery running in engine room.
  • 2. Ensure all blowers switched off
  • 3. Oil Salinity checked and found NIL (Limit – 150 Br)

Second Cold Start
Blow off the fuel pressure gauge line at 3300 RPM.

Third Cold Start
Measure quantity of Starting Fuel from 10-12 sec to 72 sec.

PARAMETERS RECORDING

0502. First Simulated Hot Start (OI Art 4.2.30/31)

Prior Start, undertake following:-
  • 1. Remove starting fuel injector and secure a container of capacity min 01 ltr
  • 2. Remove Main Burner and secure a clean container to collect at least 05 ltr of fuel
  • 3. Remove spill fuel connection and connect a hose along with a jubilee clip and secure a container to collect at least 05 ltr of fuel. Check to see no leakages.
